research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Manticore Games is researching tools to streamline game creation workflows. In Programmatically configuring materials, described as improved texturing processes utilizing smart materials for multi dimensional environments, they develop systems where creators generate objects, select smart materials, and programmatically manipulate those materials to improve texturing efficiency. Their work centers on smart material configuration and automated texturing for three dimensional game environments.

overview_description.description:
Manticore Games develops Core, a platform and community to build, share, and play online games.

Manticore Games was started by industry veterans with experience in PC, console, mobile, and VR games.

It was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in San Mateo, California.
